superseding_declaration.supersedes: training population of original declaration; no original model was fit
superseding_declaration.method: Train on unique action identity (day/window/send/activation/first-cancel/initial-size plus all causal observed features), retaining reference when paths agree. Duplicate keys with conflicting labels refuse the fit. Path-specific neutral evaluation remains separate. No threshold, feature, model parameter, policy, label, null or test date changes.
superseding_declaration.validation: Positive duplicate control and known-bad conflicting-label refusal. Full18 original controls retained. Declaration before any model fit or policy evaluation.
